area.whereItIs: **Hoskote** sits on **NH-75 Old Madras Road**, east of **Whitefield**, where the highway leaves Bangalore for **Kolar** and **Chennai**. **Soukya Road** runs in from the Whitefield side, and **Ekarajapura** sits on **Sidlaghatta Road** to the north. Further east on the same highway is **Narsapura**. Most of what we list here is **large pre-engineered buildings**, with a median clear height of **32 ft** and road links into east Bangalore.
area.whoItSuits: Hoskote suits **occupiers serving east Bangalore**, **regional distribution** into **Andhra Pradesh** and **Tamil Nadu**, and **automotive supply** into the plants further east at Narsapura and Malur. Units run from **small sheds** to **buildings over 4 lakh sq ft**, and three in four of our listings here record **loading docks**. Tell us your **size, budget and use**, and we'll shortlist across all of them.
